summary: Full-extraction pass over the 19 Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports (2014 summary to H1 2024). Added every country-of-birth row (period and since inception), every investment-category row, revenue by fee type, printed totals of the operating-account disbursement lists, NDF contribution totals and persons, the 2016 NDF and escrow account tables, and the 2015 overview with the only approvals/denials/revocations figures in the series. Line-item lists (Cabinet-approved cheques, NDF contributions by application) and most passport pie charts are left as to-dos. Most reports are scans read by OCR; every country and category table was checked against its printed totals and percentages.

observations.location: PDF p. 2, 'Six Months Summary Report' table, row 'China', column 'No. of Applications'
observations.notes: Applications received, by the applicant's country of birth as printed ("Number of Citizenship Applications received under the Programme by Country of Birth"); each application may cover a family. Recorded with breakdown birthplace= because the table is by country of birth, not nationality. Percentages not recorded. No dates and no total are printed; the 22 country counts add up to 132 and every printed percentage matches a base of 132.

new_indicators.name: Payments out of a CBI-financed account or fund
new_indicators.definition: Money paid out in a period from an account or fund financed by a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme (e.g. the CBI unit's operating account, a national development fund, an escrow fund), as listed by the programme unit. Use breakdown category= for the account.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-atg for the Antigua CIU six-monthly reports (operating-account disbursements approved by Cabinet, NDF payments, Renewable Energy Escrow payments).

new_indicators.name: Money credited to a CBI-financed account or fund
new_indicators.definition: Money credited in a period to an account or fund financed by a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as listed by the programme unit (contributions and any other receipts). Use breakdown category= for the account.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua NDF monthly credits 2016; Renewable Energy Escrow credits). Not the same as cbi_contributions, which counts only applicant donations.

new_indicators.name: People covered by listed fund contributions
new_indicators.definition: Number of people (main applicants and dependants) covered by the fund contributions a programme unit lists for a period, as printed in the list's total row.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-atg. Antigua CIU NDF contribution lists print persons and dollars in the total row.

new_indicators.name: Investment projects approved for a programme
new_indicators.definition: Number of real-estate or business projects approved as qualifying investments under a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, in a period. Use breakdown route=.
new_indicators.notes: Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua CIU overview table, 2015).
